title: 6" cocktail skewers
text: 6" cocktail skewers. These are actually longer than I wanted.  Note to self: Always get a ruler out and visualize!  That being said, I'll use them for something.  They are bamboo and have knots at one end. The end points are reasonably sharp and the side edges are smooth - without slivers. I think I should have tried the 4" for my particular appetizer - but I'll find something else for these really long 6 inchers!
